title: S69 — Evidence pack: the matching-glyph residue (5 substitutions + 4 S55 targets)
desc: GOAL: deep-dive the 5 same-length substitution misses (the whole glyph lane) + the 4 S55 §6 glyph targets: per item produce reader-stage evidence (which glyph, which decision, what would have to change) and 1-3 candidate mechanisms ranked by expected lift. WHY: S55 §6: '4 glyph items need reader/segmentation evidence, not text rules'; the 5 substitutions are the only pure-matching residue left. READ FIRST: reports/s43_failure_analysis.md (item list), reports/s55-postprocess-audit.md §4-§6, tools/matcher_variants.py. STEPS: per item: read vs label, per-position diff, piece/mask inspection, nearest confusion classes → evidence table + top candidate with a preregisterable next step. EVIDENCE: reports/glyph-residue/<date>.md + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: no reader edits — proposals only. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
